speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Welcome to your consultation; as a newborn, your caregiver will be answering for you. To begin, how old is your baby in days, and have you noticed any fever, poor feeding, or lethargy?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Syphilis. The infant is a term female with no prenatal care or immunization records; the mother's lack of care places the newborn at high risk for untreated maternal syphilis transmission, which presents with nonspecific systemic findings in the neonatal period. REQUEST TEST: RPR (Rapid Plasma Reagin) and TPHA (Treponema pallidum Hemagglutination Assay) for maternal and infant serology.
